 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner has preferred this application for grant of anticipatory bail apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case no. 8115(C) of 2021, wherein cognizance has been taken under section 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. As per the prosecution case narrated by the complainant in the complaint, the brother of the complainant ie the petitioner herein got a job in the Electricity Department on compassionate ground on the death of their father.

It is stated Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52905 of 2023(2)
dt.19-08-2023 that at the time of getting the job, he had promised to look after the family.
Instead he is not looking after the family, he grabbed the jewellery of their mother and is also purchasing land in his name by different sale deeds.

He is not abiding by the agreement entered into between Surendra Kumar Gupta vs The State Of Bihar on 19 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165217775/
1 the family members nor is he partitioning the properties.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: From the contents of the complaint as also the statement of the complainant on S.A., it is clearly evident that it is as a result of family dispute that the instant false case has been registered to put undue pressure on this petitioner.
From the complaint it would transpire that the petitioner is working in the Electricity Department.
5. Heard learned A.P.P for the State.

6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the nature of allegation in the complaint, it is directed that the petitioner, above named, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of four weeks, be released on anticipatory bail in connection with Complaint Case no.8115(C) of 2021, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.52905 of 2023(2)
dt.19-08-2023 two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-IV, Patna.

(Partha Sarthy, J) avinash/-
